Container.Name: uo-outlands
Container.Overview:
UO Outlands (Ultima Online freeshard) as a Docker container with a web desktop. On first start, the container downloads GE-Proton and the official Outlands launcher into /config and then launches the game directly. Controlled in the browser via the WebUI (KasmVNC) - no VNC client needed.
Notes: - The image must be built locally first (see the project README); it is not in any registry. - Several GB are downloaded on first start, which takes a while. Progress is shown in the WebUI. - Without a passed-through GPU, rendering runs in software (llvmpipe). For better performance, pass through /dev/dri (Extra Parameters: --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri) AND add the host's video/render group GIDs via --group-add (see README) - otherwise the GPU is detected but the game window never appears. - Extra Parameters must include --security-opt seccomp=unconfined, otherwise the 32-bit client won't start (Docker blocks modify_ldt by default). - Controlled from the XFCE desktop: the launcher and game run in a normal window, not fullscreen - otherwise the mouse is barely usable in the browser.
Not affiliated with Ultima Online or UO Outlands.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Proton, Wine prefix, and game data. Plan for at least 20 GB of free space.

Config.Name: WebUI username
Config.Description: Username for the web desktop. Empty = no login.

Config.Name: WebUI password
Config.Description: Password for the web desktop. Empty = no login, in which case the port should not be exposed to the internet.

Config.Name: Autostart launcher
Config.Description: true = launcher starts with the container. false = manual start via the UO Outlands desktop icon.

Config.Name: Restart after game exit
Config.Description: true = the launcher restarts automatically after the game exits.

Config.Name: Game window size
Config.Description: Size of the window in which the launcher and game run (virtual Wine desktop). 'auto' sizes it to the browser window.

Config.Name: Window title
Config.Description: Title shown in the browser tab

Config.Name: GPU (optional)
Config.Description: Pass through an Intel/AMD GPU. Without it, rendering falls back to software.
